title: generator's result
description: What the generator hands back, beside its Cut at .rn/<run>/rounds/<n>/generator.json: the deliverable made, or a point it can't settle.

result.description: made: the deliverable is made from the Cut. point: a point that only the user or the orchestrator can settle stops it.

carried_out.description: Where each decision of the Cut is carried out, as path:line, by the decision's path, condition, and about.

settled.description: Each point the generator settled itself, with where it lies, as path:line.

point.description: Where the result is point: the point, with the generator's recommendation and its ground.
